The epitope-specific M78 Fab was crystallized with the ebola virus thermolysin-cleaved envelope glycoprotein (EBOV GPcl) and Fab KZ52. The structure was determined by molecular replacement at 8 angstrom resolution, but was not deposited in the Protein Data Bank. The structure demonstrates that the MR78 antibody recognizes a similar site on both MARV [PDB: 3X2D] and EBOV. MR78 binds into a highly conserved hydrophobic trough revealed at the top of the EBOV GP1 core, after removal of the glycan cap by proteolytic cleavage in the endosome.
